project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Minimal Emotional Arrangement

arrangement.notes: The arrangement features sparse, minimal verses with a gradual energy build-up in the hook sections. Emotional mood is maintained with restrained instrumentation in verses and a strong dynamic presence in hooks.

event_markers.label: Verse 1 Start
event_markers.reason: First verse begins with sparse vocals

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Energy rises with strong vocal hook

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Climactic hook for final energy peak

event_markers.label: Intro Drums Fade In
event_markers.reason: Minimal drum activity to set mood

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation with minimal verses and energetic hooks
track_roles.vocal: Primary carrier of emotional content with strong hooks
track_roles.fx: Subtle effects to enhance transitions and mood

sensei_drum.brief: Create minimal yet driving drum patterns with low activity during verses and increased energy for hooks and final sections.

bass_generator.brief: Generate sparse basslines that complement the emotional mood, with more presence during hook sections.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide minimal chord progressions to sustain emotional tension, with slight increases for hooks and bridge.

melody_generator.brief: Add minimal melodic motifs that support the vocal lines without overcrowding, especially sparse in verses.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee the arrangement to maintain emotional mood with a clear energy profile focusing on strong hooks and sparse verses.

presetor.brief: Apply preset chains that favor a warm and emotional West Coast Hip-Hop sound with minimalistic textures.

songgps.brief: Manage the flow of the song ensuring smooth transitions and balanced energy buildup according to the defined energy curve.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare the mix with clarity on vocal prominence and clean separation of sparse instrumental layers.
